title: A truly magnificent experience
text:
It is hard to put in to words just how good our trip was.

We booked a private day trip to target Lynx then then Doñana. National and Natural Park.

As well as targeting the Iberian  Lynx, we also wanted to try to find Iberian Green Woodpecker and Spanish Imperial Eagle.

Our first stop for Lynx was successful, Vincent found a female which we were able to watch a close range until she was disturbed by a vehicle - but as she walked off, two cubs came out of hiding and followed her - a truly magical encounter. 

We then moved to a site where Vincent had previously had success with Iberian Green
author: C501LHrobs

title: Excellent bird tour
text: We had the best day looking at birds in Donana Park! Our guide, Fernando, was outstanding and not only showed us so many birds, but also taught us so much. It was a true highlight to our visit to Spain.
author: ChicagoValley

title: Outstanding birding experience in Doñana
text:
For any birder visiting southern Spain, a trip to Parque Nacional de Doñana with Doñana Wings is a must.

From our first contact, Vicent was responsive, helpful, and well-organized. He walked us through the various tour options, made solid recommendations on what to bring, and as the trip approached sent us our guide’s name and a Google Maps pin for the pickup location in Sevilla, which was coordinated to within a three-minute walk of our hotel. Logistics like that matter, and they nailed it.

author: cznbill

title: Great Tour
text: Vincent gave us a wonderful day’s birding. We saw nearly 70 species. He has great local  knowledge and a very relaxed style which made for a most enjoyable trip to Donana.
author: grsmith47

title: The perfect guided day trip from Sevilla.
text: Vicente is a perfect birding guide , his pre trip advice, responses and support were always exactly as we required and his expert friendly guidance and targeted itinerary could not have been better. The marvelous landscapes and wildlife he showed us were stunning and fascinating and the birds exceeded our expectations. We got everything we could have asked for in a day trip. Several new lifer species and many of the best views of target species we had asked about absolutely brilliant experience
author: TimothyM310

title: A fantastic birding experience
text:
Four of us booked a personal tour, with pick-up and drop-off in Seville, and had a very entertaining time in northern Donana - with the birds and chatting with our guide, Vicent. Our final tally was 65 species, plus another seven heard - not bad for a day trip! We can’t choose our favourites, there were too many, but the overall memories will be of such an abundance of birds of each species - Spoonbills, Black Kites, White Storks, egrets of all types, Night Herons, Squaccos, and especially the flock of 14 Turtle Doves and the many pairs of Marbled Ducks!
Vicent is a very knowledgable, helpful
author: sheenamary

title: Fantastic 11-hour tour
text: We had an excellent 11-hour tour led by Maria from Donana Wings. As keen birders from the UK, we can vouch for Maria's impressive knowledge of birds and local sites. We saw well over 100 species, with numerous highlights (penduline tit, marbled duck, griffon vulture, lesser kestrel, black stork, purple & squacco heron etc etc). Highly recommended and superb value.

title: Bird watching at its best!
text:
I was absolutely thrilled with this tour! Vicent was very knowledgeable about the birds and the ecosystem of Doñana.  We saw over 50 species. Without this tour, I probably would have been able to identify only five birds!
I highly recommend Doñana Wings company.
author: Chiik

title: Great birding near Sevilla
text: I did two days of great birding with Vicent. He is really a keen and excellent birder who fulfilled my wishlist. I can highly recommend this guide.
